what: Image inside the panel (data-fx-part="image", if absent, data-fx-part="label" text) is placed on the six faces of a glass box with .06 per side — on each face the image is warped by as much as the line of sight bends at a refractive index of 1.5, warped harder the closer it is to within .22 of a corner (curvature 1.5), and red, green and blue are split apart by .8 so a rainbow fringe appears. Face edges are bright lines, and the more obliquely it is viewed the stronger the reflection (Fresnel to the 3rd power). Dragging rotates it on world axes (.01rad per 1px), on release inertia decays by .95 each frame, and if held still while grabbed it stops quickly at .5. Left alone, it floats on a sine (1.2 per second · amplitude .004) and turns .002rad each frame.

options.friction: Inertia after release (share left per frame), default .95
options.hold: Share left over when stopped while held, default .5
options.spin: Rotation per frame (rad) when idle, default .002
options.[data-fx-part=image]: Image (img) to place in the box — fitted to 80% of the square
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Text to show when there is no image (first 6 chars, in the text’s color, weight and font)

note: three must be global (window.THREE). Load library/_vendor/three@0.155.0/build/three.cjs after three-global.js (see demo.html). The original refracts a separately drawn plate (1024², render target) holding the inner logo 3D model, but this part captures the art and text inside the plate with a canvas. On touch devices it doesn’t accept dragging, so it doesn’t block page scroll (only the floating spin remains).

from.where: index.html glass display case #webgl (stage.js boxMat) — original BEVEL 1.5 · DISPERSION .8, DRAG sensitivity .01 · inertia .95 · noise .5, FLOAT 1.2 · .004 · .002
